content.short: World App provides cutting-edge infrastructure for software wallets, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: World App is the first wallet built for the Worldcoin ecosystem, providing identity verification and universal basic income access. As a prominent player in the Web3 Wallets space, World App specializes in delivering high-quality software wallets infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Ethereum, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, World App focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
content.meta: World App is redefining software wallets on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore World App directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
